programmes.d: Lynn gets upset when she learns that her record label is pushing back the release of her album to promote another artist, Chrisette Michele.

Four girlfriends: picky lawyer Joan, gold-digging real estate agent Toni, professional student Lynn, and Joan's headstrong assistant Maya get involved with each other's loves and lives, particularly after Toni starts dating Joan's ex.
Joan, who hasn't had sex in a year, decides to have a one-night stand with handsome restaurateur Davis.

Joan, Toni, and Lynn decide to find dates on the Internet. When Joan meets Marcus she thinks he is too good to be true until she finds out he wears a girdle. Toni breaks it off with her date simply because he's too black.
Joan's new boyfriend Marcus has been moving a bit too fast and she realizes her heart was not in the relationship in the first place.
With Maya and Joan becoming close friends, Toni becomes jealous and feels she's losing her best friend.

programmes.t: Girlfriends: The Importance of Being Frank
programmes.d: Joan starts dating her client's very attractive accountant Keith, only to be stalked by his estranged wife.
Joan learns that Maya's husband may be cheating on her and must face whether or not it's a good idea to tell her friend. Toni dates a City Councilman who can help further her career.
Maya and her partner Darnell decide they want to renew their vows and have a formal wedding ceremony. Joan offers to help with the event and to have it at her home.

programmes.t: Girlfriends: The Remains of the Date
programmes.d: Joan is determined to play the ultimate Halloween prank on William and succeeds. Meanwhile, Toni is left to deal with her dates strange sexual fetish for stuffed animals.
On a holiday that emphasizes togetherness, Joan struggles with feelings of loneliness and separation on Thanksgiving.

Baby has never been in Joan's vocabulary until she gets the scare of her life and a new perspective on her priorities. As a result, the girls come together to give their love and support, showing their true Girlfriend friendship.
Dreading another dateless weekend, the girls and William try Maya's suggestion to make a list of what they want in a mate.
Joan's new boyfriend Sean has not made a move on her after three weeks of dating and she is beginning to wonder why.
Joan begins to question her relationship with Sean when he gives her a power drill for Valentine's and doesn't hear from him for three days.
Joan decides it is time to give in on her three-month rule and she is finally going to have sex with her boyfriend Sean.
Joan and Toni decide that Lynn needs to learn to be independent. They give her a week to find a job, then she is on her own.
Joan discovers that being the only black woman at her firm has many disadvantages and she is constantly ignored and overlooked.
Maya checks into the hospital for her fibroid surgery and Joan has trouble managing her time between her boyfriend and her friends.
Joan is stressing because Sean hasn't told her that he loves her.
Sean notices that Joan always flirts with Davis. He gets jealous and tells Joan that she can never see Davis again or go back to 847.
Joan opens her mouth and tells Greg about Toni and Clay.
Joan takes the girls to the Sinbad Music Festival to help ease Toni to get over her breakup with Greg.
The ladies return home from their very eventful trip to Jamaica where Joan unintentionally ruined Toni's relationship.
Joan continues to suffer in her troubled friendship with Toni and her new relationship with her therapist, Dr. Bales.
Torn between her two worlds, Joan struggles with her professional duty while at the same time dealing with the guilt that she is not being true to herself or her beliefs.

Maya buys a dress that is too expensive knowing it might cause problems with her husband, Darnell. Joan treats herself to a trip to New York to visit her boyfriend, realizing the distance between the two of them is a problem.

Joan ends the friendship between her and Toni after finding out that Toni has been discussing her personal life with co-workers behind her back. Meanwhile, Lynn is trying to cope with her new living situation with Vosco, and his lack of a job.

Yvonne is concerned that William is never going to marry her because they have not set a date for the wedding. When Yvonne asks Joan for advice, Joan tries her best to stay out of it but ends up telling Yvonne to move in with William first to try it out.
For her thirtieth birthday, Joan finds that she is happy with who she is, yet finds that she’s not so happy that her father is a nudist.
When Toni loses her friend Joan, her man, and her gold card, it’s up to Maya and Lynn to help her get her life back together.
Due to marital tensions at home, an emotionally fragile Maya finds herself falling into a fantasy affair with a handsome and empathetic new friend, Stan.
Toni meets a great man but is dumped after she’s a bad influence on his eight-year-old daughter. Joan dates a movie star but is dumped when he begins to think she’s stalking him.
Maya refuses to end her relationship with Stan, despite her girlfriends' repeated warnings to do so.

programmes.t: Girlfriends: I Have a Dream House
programmes.d: As a gesture of his love, William buys a beautiful house for his fiance, Yvonne.
Lynn's Caucasian sister, Tanya, travels to LA to help Lynn celebrate her Gotcha Day: the day when Lynn's childhood adoption to her Caucasian family became legal.

programmes.t: Girlfriends: Willie or Won’t He II: The Last Chapter
programmes.d: The week of William and Yvonne's wedding is finally here and all goes smoothly until Yvonne discovers William never told his mother about Yvonne...ever.

After a horrid kiss, Maya finally realizes she must end her relationship with Stan. Afterward, however, Stan deviously becomes good friends with Maya’s husband, just to make Maya squirm as he says he may or may not tell her husband about them.

programmes.t: Girlfriends: Take Me Out After the Ball Game
programmes.d: As the company softball season kicks off, Joan falls for her new teammate: a young new employee from the mailroom; however, things go sour when she publicly dismisses their relationship due to their age difference.
Toni decides to make something of her life by opening her own exclusive real estate agency after she sells a four-point-two million-dollar property.

programmes.t: Girlfriends: X Does Not Mark the Spot
programmes.d: Joan becomes more adventurous with her boyfriend Chris, but inadvertently takes Ecstasy at a club with him and has a bad trip that puts her into the hospital.

programmes.t: Girlfriends: The Taming of the Realtess
programmes.d: Toni is frantic as the grand opening of her real estate agency is less than a week away.

Just before Mother’s Day, Maya is disturbed when her mother announces she’s selling the house and moving to San Bernardino with her boyfriend. Toni has issues when her mother shows up unannounced for Mother’s Day and continually embarrasses her.
Unable to work out living with Joan, Lynn moves in with William and the two hit it off in more ways than one; becoming casual, unattached sex buddies.
Joan dumps Chris when she learns her ex-boyfriend, Sean, is moving back to town; but is crushed when Sean lies about being engaged just to avoid being in a relationship with her again.
Maya dreams of reuniting with Darnell, Lynn becomes a bartender and William tries to fast-track his partnership at the law firm.
Maya struggles to save her marriage.
Eager to meet new men, Joan throws a "Bring Your Ex" party
Toni wrestles with growing older, and William makes a love connection.
Joan is not crazy about William’s new girlfriend, while Toni’s plastic surgeon comes up short on the dating front.

programmes.d: While Maya tries to hide her marital woes from her mother, Lynn faces a financial reckoning with her parents
Joan meets a movie star who isn’t as deep as he seems, and William’s sister makes a surprising request.
Joan discovers that dating a screen star isn’t as glamorous as it seems.
Lynn’s long-lost birth mother resurfaces after 30 years

William’s ambitious girlfriend has big plans that are alienating him from Joan, Lynn, Maya, and Toni.
